composition.coaching_note: Luis, you said, "Let's do your plan review tomorrow morning — that's about 20 hours from now." However, you collected the SOA at 02:44, which means you should have waited at least 24 hours before scheduling the appointment. In the future, please wait the required 24 hours before scheduling an appointment after collecting the SOA to ensure the customer has time to review and sign the document.
composition.summary: The agent failed to wait the required 24 hours before scheduling an appointment after collecting the Scope of Appointment. The agent should wait at least 24 hours before scheduling an appointment after collecting the SOA to ensure the customer has time to review and sign the document.

extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?
